summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Vehicle HMI Dashboard for 1989 Honda Accord. All backend APIs and frontend components working perfectly with custom PNG gauge assets.
passed_tests: Vehicle data simulation with real-time updates
Custom PNG gauge assets loading and displaying correctly
RPM gauge with needle rotation and VTEC/shift light effects
Speed gauge with accurate needle positioning
Shift lights bar (7 LEDs) progressive lighting with RPM
Digital speed display showing real-time MPH values
Gear indicator with prev/current/next gear display
Indicators row (CEL, MAINT, turn signals) functioning
Fuel and coolant bars with proper warning states
Settings panel with theme selection (Type R, Retro '89, Clean OEM)
Theme switching with visual previews working
Diagnostics panel showing comprehensive OBD-style data
Data source switching between Simulated and OBD modes
Real-time data consistency between vehicle-data and diagnostics APIs
No console errors or JavaScript issues detected
